content.text: {"id": "mm6942e1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Analysis of 114,411 COVID-19–associated deaths reported to National Vital Statistics System during May–August 2020"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The percentage of decedents who were White decreased from 56.9% to 51.5%"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The number of COVID-19–associated deaths decreased from 37,940 in May to 17,718 in June"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The percentage of decedents who were White decreased from 56.9% to 51.5%"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 78.2% of decedents were aged ≥65 years, and 53.3% were male"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the percentage who were Hispanic increased from 16.3% to 26.4%"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Black persons still accounted for 18.7% of overall deaths despite representing just 12.5% of the U.S. population"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This report describes demographic and geographic trends in COVID-19–associated deaths"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "to describe changes in demographic features over time"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "percentages of deaths among two age groups (≥65 years and <65 years), racial and ethnic groups, and U.S. Census region were calculated for each month"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "R statistical software (version 3.6.3; The R Foundation) was used to tabulate death counts and generate histograms."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "counts <10 are suppressed in NVSS to maintain confidentiality"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
